why: I checked both briefs against the two must_not items, and neither one is broken. (1) No verifier check gets its PASS or FAIL from `npm run test:cli`. Check 6 runs "npm test; echo "exit=$?"". The advisory note even points out that package.json has no test:cli script and tells the verifier to "Use `npm test` for check 6." (2) The builder brief never asks for a general separator option. Step 1 only looks for '--tsv' and calls parse(text, '\t'). Step 2 rules the option out directly: "Do not add ... a general --sep/--delimiter option". The verifier's optional extras also look for scope creep ("no --sep"), which agrees with the non-goals. So the criterion holds for the whole output.
